description: DRAFT: the 16 physical attack cards from PLAN.md (rules v0.17, Phase c2), for card faces and placeholder art only. The engine does not read this file. When Phase c2 is built, these move into cards.prototype.json with a 'physical' kind in the schema. Tiers: minor (penalty 1 turn), major (target's Toughness roll -1, penalty 2), brutal (Toughness -1, severity +1, penalty 3). toughness and severity are the card's final modifiers, with its own text already applied (null: the card never makes that roll). uses: 'speed' attacks with Speed, 'muscle' with Defense. bonus is added to the attack. affinity is the body Affinity that gives +1.

cards.name: Shirt Pull
cards.text: No knockdown: the target only drops the ball.

cards.name: Tripping
cards.text: +2 more if the target holds the ball.

cards.name: Hooking
cards.text: You may attack the opposing player in the next lane of the same row instead.

cards.name: Atomic Wedgie
cards.text: No Toughness roll: if you win, the target is Shaken, never worse.

cards.name: Gouge
cards.text: If the target passes their Toughness roll, they're Shaken anyway.

cards.name: Late Hit
cards.when: After the opposing player in this spot passes or shoots.
cards.text: No ball to drop: it can only hurt.

cards.name: Elbow
cards.when: When the opposing player in this spot beats yours in a contest.

cards.name: Kneecap
cards.text: If the target is hurt, Shaken counts as Injured.

cards.name: Spearing
cards.text: Your player makes a Toughness roll too, win or lose.

cards.name: Pile-on
cards.text: +1 for each of your standing players in the next lane of the same row.
